Hello, my name is Gabriela Shirley! 

I am a recent graduate from the [University of California, San Diego](https://ucsd.edu/) majoring in __Computer Science__.

I am driven to expand my horizons in different types of fields and hope to use my accumulated knowledge to make an impact on my community and even the world. Although I am focusing on Computer Science, specifically Web/Software Engineer, I am also studying design and human cognition in order to combine both my technical and personal skills and create new applications that will ultimately help others.

I am passionate about being a woman agent of change with my work in the tech field and willing to get hands-on with any websites, applications, or anything in between.

Please feel free to reach me out for any inquiries! (◔ᴥ◔)
